properties.displayName: NovaSteel: restrict Fabric capacity SKU to the approved demo/measurement set
properties.description: Prevents an unreviewed jump to a larger, costlier Fabric F SKU. Deployment-topology.md §6: F2 is the cost-conscious starting SKU, F4 is the measured-contention fallback, and F8 is the pre-approved demo-day burst tier requestable from the portal capacity dialog with a recorded reason. Anything above F8 requires a separate change/cost-owner sign-off and an update to this parameter.

metadata.description: Default permits only the pre-approved cost-conscious set (F2 baseline, F4 measured fallback, F8 demo-day burst). A production SKU decision requires updating this parameter as part of a reviewed change.
